dedupe_keys.name: performance database for reinforced concrete columns with spiral reinforcement

description: Performance Database for Reinforced Concrete Columns with Spiral Reinforcement is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Ekin Gultepe, University of Canterbury (canterbury.ac.nz). The database was assembled by researchers at the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), who collected data from 92 tests (Taylor and Stone, 1993). This performance database contains material and geometric properties, experimental results and reference information from cyclic, lateral-load tests of reinforced concrete columns with spiral reinforcement or circular hoops. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 5 top-level files (CSV). Its DOI is 10.4231/d32f7jr0c. Keywords: spiral reinforcement , reinforced concrete, column, earthquake engineering , databases, NIST. Published 2013-03-08. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
